topic: Documentation requirements for Dubai business setup
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on required documentation for a business setup in Dubai. Initial requests included signing and stamping documents, followed by questions regarding the Trade License and Company Registration.

[p2] stated that previously submitted Company Registration was insufficient. Regarding the Trade License, [p5] suggested checking if an export license was needed, though noting it is usually unnecessary. [p2] agreed to clarify the specific requirements with the requesting party.
decisions: The documentation requirement for the Trade License needs clarification from the external party.
action_items: [p2] will clarify the required documentation (specifically regarding the Trade License) with the concerned parties.
